Togaru Kamakiri (Provisional License).name: Togaru Kamakiri (Provisional License)
Togaru Kamakiri (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Togaru Kamakiri, hero name Jack Mantis, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and may now act as a hero in an emergency. Bright-green mohawk, a mantis-like face with hooked cheek blades; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Sharp, clipped challenges; dares instead of requests.
Combat Role: Close-range bladesman who cuts for rescue as readily as for capture.
Under Pressure: Still charges first, but asks what needs cutting before who needs beating.
Togaru Kamakiri (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Strangers see a villain's face; his license says rescuer. Motivation: Prove he earned it on judgment, not just aggression. Canon voice & behavior: Cuts a trapped person free before he hunts the villain; still challenges any 1-A student he passes. Thread: Whether a face this fierce can make frightened people feel safe.
QUIRK: Razor Sharp with cleaner control; he never aims a lethal cut at a classmate.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed, with all of 1-B.
personality: Hot-blooded: Answers a challenge before it is finished.
Competitive: Wanted 1-B to pass as a whole class, and wanted to be first through.
Rescue-minded: Reaches for the rope, rubble or lock before the opponent.
Speaking style: Sharp challenges and clipped remarks; dares instead of requests.
abilities: Razor Sharp: Grows real blades from his body with practiced control; every swing near a person is a risk.
Rescue cutting: Cuts people free of rope, wreckage or locked doors; harder material resists the edge.
Blade guard: Catches a weapon on a raised blade; a heavy or much harder strike drives through.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency; not yet a full license.
Fighting style: Opens with pressure, cuts away cover or restraints, and plays for the team capture, not a solo win.
Togaru Kamakiri (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with a bright-green mohawk, narrow, slanted eyes under sharp brows, light skin and a lean build. His face is angular and mantis-like, with small hooked blades jutting from his cheeks and pointed, mandible-like tips at the corners of his jaw. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Focused, steady scowl.
